notes: 🧮 New: Trade Calculator. A 🧮 Tools button now sits in the top toolbar (next to Portfolio). Tap it and enter your own numbers — entry price, how much you're putting in, your exit as a % gain or a sell price, and your brokerage — and it shows your real net profit, the full cost breakdown, and your break-even move (the % rise needed just to cover costs). Pure arithmetic on the numbers you type: it makes no prediction about whether a trade will win. Nothing is assumed — change any field and it all updates. Opens as an overlay; tap again, the ✕, or outside it to close.
